idea: Competition and bid writing service for architects
pain: Bids are written badly at midnight by designers
v1: One competition submission written and edited
verdict: Warm channel and real pain, but low fees from a poor buyer and pure hours.

why.distribution: Directly reachable practices who bid constantly.
why.demand: Bid consultants exist and are paid, so a substitute market is real.
why.fmf: She can write at professional standard and understands what the submission must argue.
why.revenue_structure: Repeat purchase as bids recur, but no contract.
why.defensibility: Bid writers are numerous and cheap.
why.leverage: Pure hours against someone else's deadline.
why.ceiling: £3.5k x 30 bids = £105k, at 30 deadline-driven projects a year.

ceiling_arithmetic: £3.5k x 30 bids = £105k, and thirty bid deadlines a year is punishing part-time work. Realistic: 10-15 = £35-52k.
carries: Immediate revenue from the warmest possible channel.
kills: Low fees, no leverage, deadline-driven, and the buyer has no money.
test: Offer to write one bid for £3k.
test_pass: They pay and come back for the next one.
test_fail: They ask her to do it on a success fee.
